title: SpatialContext
description: Spatial A — static approved location catalog + RouteProfile set. One hash-bound main-side bootstrap/runtime configuration file. Coordinates are optional non-authoritative metadata (integer microdegrees only). Existing RouteProfile remains the sole v1 travel-duration authority. No production geography inventing; Actual Yukino life remains unstarted.

spatial_context_version.description: Human/version identity. Not a substitute for context_hash content identity.

locations.description: LocationEntry records. Canonical sort by location_id. Empty valid.

route_profiles.description: Existing RouteProfile records. Canonical sort by route_profile_id. Empty valid. Do not invent reverse routes.

context_hash.description: SHA-256 over normalized semantic payload excluding context_hash itself.

label.description: Optional internal/display label. Absence only — not nullable.

geo_anchor.description: Optional non-authoritative map metadata. Absence only — not nullable.

lat_e6.description: Latitude in integer microdegrees. No decimal-degree conversion.

lon_e6.description: Longitude in integer microdegrees. No decimal-degree conversion.

radius_m.description: AREA => >= 1; PUBLIC_POINT / SYNTHETIC_POINT => == 0. Semantic layer enforces precision pairing.
